name: What permits are required to build a foundation-based tiny home in San Diego County?

mainEntity.name: What permits are required to build a foundation-based tiny home in San Diego County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building a foundation-based tiny home in San Diego County requires various permits, including a building permit, zoning approval, and potentially permits for grading, electrical, plumbing, and septic/sewer connections. These homes must comply with California's Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) laws and local zoning ordinances. Specific requirements can vary by municipality within the county, such as Escondido or Oceanside. It is essential to consult with the local planning department and a qualified builder to understand all necessary permits for your specific location and project.
acceptedAnswer.description: You need building and zoning permits, plus others for utilities, in San Diego County for a foundation-based tiny home, adhering to ADU laws.
